name: Alexis Gauba
title: Co-Founder
bio: Alexis Gauba is the Co-Founder of Dawn, a company that provides product analytics exclusively for AI products, allowing companies to make better marketing and product decisions. Gauba is a UC Berkeley alumni and has completed various research in blockchain.

name: Kavita Shah
title: Founder
investors: Wing VC is the Lead, Tokyo Black, and some Meta excecutive angels
bio: Kavita Shah is the Co-Founder and Head of Product of Inventive, which embeds a conversational AI analyst into SaaS products so users can explore and act on their data in natural language; the company launched with a $6.5M seed. Shah previously led the apps team at People.ai and began her career on YouTube/Google's monetization team. She holds a B.A. in international relations from Stanford and an MBA from MIT Sloan.

name: Deeya Viradia
title: Co-Founder & CTO
stage_raw: Early (founder is a UC Berkeley entrepreneur)
bio: Deeya Viradia is the Co-Founder and CTO of Quant (quant²), a marketplace for quantum-inspired financial algorithms. An engineering-physics student at UC Berkeley, she founded Berkeley's first experimental quantum-computing club and has done research at UC Berkeley's Quantum Devices Group, SLAC, and a DoD quantum lab.

name: Amira Valliani
title: Founder & CEO
investors: Greycroft(lead), Alumni Ventures, Revolution's Rise of the Rest Seed Fund, Liquid2 Ventures
bio: Amira Valliani is the Founder and CEO of Glow, a podcast- and creator-monetization platform acquired by Libsyn (LSYN) in April 2021; by acquisition Glow was powering hundreds of thousands of transactions for podcasters and remains the default membership platform for 50,000+ podcasters globally. Before Glow, Valliani served in the Obama White House as a senior advisor and as a speechwriter to Secretary of State Hillary Clinton. She holds an MBA from the Wharton School and an MPA from the Harvard Kennedy School.

name: Harish Venkatesan
title: Co-Founder & CEO
invest: No large public VC rounds disclosed
bio: Harish Venkatesan is the Co-Founder and CEO of Designlab, an online education platform offering mentor-guided courses in UX/UI and product design. Before Designlab, Venkatesan worked at Venmo and Grubwithus and co-founded TickrTalk while at the University of Pennsylvania. He holds a B.S. in systems engineering from the University of Pennsylvania.

name: Ashwini Iyer
title: Co-Founder
bio: Ashwini Iyer is the Co-Founder and product lead of Pamastay, a healthcare payment-integrity and compliance platform that replaces ad-hoc, spreadsheet-driven investigations with AI-assisted, auditable workflows built for regulatory scrutiny. Iyer previously worked at Verkada and HireVue.

name: Larissa Tyagi
investors: Y Combinator, (Primary partner is Gustaf Alstromer)
bio: Larissa Tyagi is the Co-Founder and CEO of Theora (formerly Louiza Labs, YC S25), which builds analyst-grade AI for biopharma — datasets and high-fidelity training environments, including de-identified EHR/PACS data, that teach AI agents how real-world medicine is practiced. Tyagi previously worked as a software engineer at Apple and holds dual degrees in computer/information systems and business from Carnegie Mellon University.

name: Ansh Sheth
title: Co-Founder
bio: Ansh Sheth is a Co-Founder of Bizzy AI (Y Combinator S25), a startup building AI agents that automate sales and go-to-market workflows. Sheth is a member of Harker's Class of 2024.

name: Mariam & Sona Sulakian
investors: Nat friedman and Daniel Gross are Leads, Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Liquid2 Ventures
bio: Pincites, co-founded by Mariam & Sona Sulakian, built AI that helps legal teams review and negotiate contracts faster. It was acquired by Filevine in January 2026.

name: Johnny Wang
title: Founder
bio: Johnny Wang is the Co-Founder of Hinoki Security, a Y Combinator–backed cybersecurity startup building a unified platform for continuous vulnerability scanning and patching. Wang studied computer science at Columbia and worked in security at several companies including Google, and previously co-founded Crosswire, an enterprise access-management startup. He also advises Jericho Security.

name: Zhou Emily
title: Co-Founder, CEO
bio: Emily Zhou is the Co-Founder and CEO of Sound of Molecules (SoMol), a drug-discovery startup built on 'molecular sonification' — a multi-modal AI approach that encodes molecular structures as sound to help models better identify promising drug candidates. Zhou is a Harker alumna and young researcher whose work on the method has been presented in academic settings.

name: Andrew Luo
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Andrew Luo is the Co-Founder and CEO of OneSchema, a company dedicated to customer data migration and integration optimization using AI. OneSchema works to automate and simplify data onboarding to improve workflows. Luo is also a Stanford alumnus and listed as one of Forbes' 2022 30 under 30.

name: Katie Siegel
title: Co founder CEO
bio: Katie Siegel is the Co-Founder and CEO of Flipturn, an EV fleet charging-management software company that was acquired by Einride in 2026. Siegel was previously a senior engineering manager at Samsara and worked at Dropbox, SingleStore, and the MIT Media Lab. She holds an engineering degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

name: Ketul Patel
title: Founder
bio: Ketul Patel is the Founder of AltitudeIQ, a startup building autonomous AI agents that deploy and run SAP and other enterprise systems, paired with a data-quality engine that keeps those systems accurate. He is a member of Harker's Class of 2010.

name: Suraj Pakala
title: Founder
bio: Suraj Pakala '19 is building a company in stealth.

name: Arvind Ramgopal
title: Founder & CTO
bio: Arvind Ramgopal is the Founder and CTO of Upward, which helps real-estate and building operators collect, store, and use building-energy data to automate compliance and cut energy costs. Ramgopal previously worked at Palo Alto Networks, Lume Health, IBM iX, and MetricStream, and studied at New York University.

name: Manan Shah
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Manan Shah is the Founder and CEO of Backbone, a clinical AI layer for healthcare payments that automates medical claims and payer workflows. A Harker alumnus and Stanford graduate, Shah was previously a founding engineer at Kumo AI, where he worked on relational deep learning, and was a national finalist in the Siemens Competition.

name: Senan Ebrahim
title: Founder and CEO

bio: Delfina is a pregnancy care platform co-founded by physician-scientist Senan Ebrahim, who holds an MD and PhD in Computational Neuroscience from Harvard University. The platform uses proprietary predictive models to help care teams assess patient risk profiles and personalize care plans to improve maternal and child health outcomes. Ebrahim previously founded Hikma Health, a nonprofit providing a free health data platform for refugee and low-income populations.

name: Ravi Kapur
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Ravi Kapur is the Founder and CEO of Diya TV, America's first South Asian broadcast television network, which he launched in 2009 and grew to reach 85M+ viewers with news and cultural programming. Before Diya TV, Kapur was an anchor, reporter, and producer for ABC, CBS, and NBC affiliates and testified before Congress on preserving free local television. He holds a degree from Syracuse University.

name: Adrik Mcllroy
bio: Adrik McIlroy is the Founder of Glassfrog, a contactless physiological-sensing company whose under-the-mattress sensor measures heart rate, heart-rate variability, and breathing by detecting tiny density changes in an electric field — no wearables required.

name: Surbhi Sarna
title: Founder
bio: Surbhi Sarna is the founder of Collate, which uses AI to create and streamline accurate documentation for diagnostic, medical device, and drug development companies, thereby reducing time to market and expediting the creation of life-saving innovations. Surbhi is an UC Berkeley alumn. In addition to her background in microbiology and bioengineering, she also has VC experience as a GP in Y Combinator and entreprenuerial experience, with successful exits under her belt.

name: Suhaas Prasad
title: Founder & CTO
investors: Pathlight Ventures, Nebular, Haystack, Bertelsmann Investments
bio: Suhaas Prasad is the Founder and CTO of Onos Health, a behaviorial technology company that works to streamline operations and reduce loss to ensure higher quality of care. It also aims to ensure members receive appropriate care for their needs. Prasad was also the CTO and Co-Founder of Aspire.

name: Gobi Dasu
title: Founder
bio: Gobi Dasu is the Founder and CEO of LD Talent, a future-of-work platform that helps companies find and manage vetted, motivated remote developers, AI/ML experts, and designers, using financially-incentivized upskilling to match talent at competitive rates. He holds a B.S. and M.S. in computer science from Stanford and is a PhD candidate in human-computer interaction at Northwestern University.

name: Gobi Dasu
title: Founder
bio: Gobi Dasu is the Founder of Hailcube, a human-AI platform for upskilling and matching diverse global tech talent — the successor to his developer marketplace LD Talent. He holds a B.S. and M.S. in computer science from Stanford and is a PhD candidate in human-computer interaction at Northwestern University.

name: Nikhil Reddy
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Nikhil Reddy is the CEO of Kaizen Labs, a platform to help residents register for various local and state activities to connect with the community. Reddy is a UC Berkeley alumnus and worked as a Software Engineer at various companies, including Tesla.

name: Dawson Chen
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Dawson Chen is the Co-Founder and CEO of Letterbook (YC S23), an AI-native customer-support platform whose agent connects to a company's inbox and database to draft replies to every ticket for human approval. Chen previously co-founded the AI assistant Martin, which grew to ~100,000 users. He studied computer science and economics at Yale University.

name: Varun Sivaram
title: Co Founder CEO
investors: Radical Ventures (lead), NVentures, AMPLO, CRV, Neotribe, Lowercarbon Capital (lead), Salesforce, National Grid Partners, Earthshot, Trust Ventures, Hohn Doerr (angel), Energy Impact Partners (lead), Eaton, GE Vernova, InQTel, Samsung Ventures, Siemens, NVentures
bio: Emerald AI, founded by Varun Sivaram, makes AI data centers grid-flexible — orchestrating compute to reduce power draw during peak grid demand. It launched in 2025 with a $24.5M seed backed by Radical Ventures and NVIDIA.

name: Nicholas Chuang
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Nicholas Chuang '13 is building a company in stealth.

name: Dawson Chen
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Dawson Chen is the Co-Founder and CEO of Martin, an AI personal-assistant app — inspired by 'Jarvis' — that manages tasks, messages, and schedules and grew to roughly 100,000 users. Chen went on to co-found Letterbook (YC S23) and has worked with Y Combinator, NASA, and Stanford. He studied computer science and economics at Yale University.

name: Alex Lan
title: Co-Founder
bio: Alex Lan is the Co-Founder and CEO of Agora, an independent intelligence platform that helps companies discover, evaluate, prioritize, and measure the ROI of AI tools and vendors across their organization. Lan is a member of Harker's Class of 2023.

name: Rishabh Jain
bio: Rishabh Jain is the Co-Founder and CEO of Latent (Latent Health, YC W23), which builds medical language models that automate healthcare operations such as prior authorization to get patients their medications faster; the company has raised an $80M Series A at roughly a $600M valuation. A repeat founder, Jain previously spent over a decade in healthcare at Omada Health and Two Chairs.

name: Denzil Eden
title: Founder & CEO
investors:
Apple Core Holdings
IrrvntVC
Sugar Free Capital
bio: Denzil Eden is the founder and CEO of Smarty, an AI-powered productivity assistant that helps users manage meetings and complex scheduling tasks using natural language. Founded in 2017, Smarty operates as a cloud-based platform designed to simplify workflows and boost efficiency. Eden earned her AI-focused degree from MIT and an MBA from Harvard, and previously worked at Microsoft. She has raised $2 million in seed funding to grow the company.

name: Rajiv Sancheti
title: Co-Founder
bio: Rajiv Sancheti is a Co-Founder of Caddy (YC F25), a personal AI for everyday work that lives in your text messages — surfacing important items from your email, calendar, and apps and acting on them when you reply. Before Caddy, Sancheti spent four years at Loom, where he helped lead product and design for Loom's AI suite.

name: Karun Kaushik
title: Co-founder
bio: Karun Kaushik is the Co-Founder and CEO of Delve, an AI platform that helps fast-growing companies achieve SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance in days rather than months. Kaushik started Delve with co-founder Selin Kocalar after they met as MIT freshmen; both are Forbes '30 Under 30' honorees. The company went through Y Combinator and has raised a Series A.

name: Brandon Yang
title: Co-Founder
bio: Brandon Yang is a Co-Founder of Cartesia, which builds real-time generative voice and audio AI, including ultra-low-latency text-to-speech models for voice agents. The Cartesia founding team met as researchers at the Stanford AI Lab, where they pioneered state space models (SSMs) — efficient architectures for foundation models. Before Cartesia, Yang was a tech lead manager at Snorkel AI and researched at the Stanford AI Lab and Google Brain. He holds a B.S. in computer science from Stanford University, where he is on leave from a CS PhD.

name: Matthew Huang
bio: Matthew Huang is a Co-Founder of Lowkey, a social platform that let gamers automatically record, review, and share their best gameplay moments; Niantic acquired the company in 2021. Huang built Lowkey alongside co-founders Jesse Zhang and Melissa Yu.

name: Namrata Anand
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Namrata Anand is the founder of Diffuse Bio, a biotechnology company specializing in generative AI for protein design. Their mission is to create AI systems that engineer novel, useful proteins with exceptional precision. Namrata holds a PhD in bioengineering from Stanford, where she focused on computational protein design, and is also a Harvard alumna.

name: Eugene Huang
title: Co-Founder
bio: Eugene Huang is a Co-Founder of Torch, a health-tech startup that unified a person's scattered medical records — from hospitals, labs, and wearables — into one AI-readable system; OpenAI acquired Torch in 2026 to strengthen ChatGPT's health capabilities. Huang and his co-founder previously worked together at the primary-care startup Forward Health.

name: Shantanu Joshi
bio: Shantanu Joshi is a Co-Founder of Lume, a banking app for nurses offering earned-wage access, student-loan and debt refinancing, and travel-nurse job recommendations. He co-founded Lume with Christopher Chang, and Vivian Health acquired Lume's technology in 2022. Joshi has also founded several other startups, including the last-mile delivery platform Tortoise AI and the ML-deployment tool Vapor.ai.

name: Nemo Yang
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Cortex, founded by Nemo Yang, is an AI desktop app that automates document-to-software data entry across accounting, legal, and mortgage/lending workflows — reading PDFs and entering the data into tools like QuickBooks and Salesforce.

name: Ravi Mishra
bio: Ravi Mishra is a Co-Founder of Potluck Labs, a research studio that explores, prototypes, and ships consumer apps.

bio: Chris Hailey is a Co-Founder of OS3 (YC S26), a robotics company building semi-humanoid robots for real physical labor — pairing in-house hardware with AI models, with early deployments in hospitality. He previously co-founded Observee, which built integration infrastructure for vertical-AI companies: a single API and marketplace of 1,000+ Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for AI agents. Before founding these companies, Hailey worked as a software engineer at Coinbase. He holds a computer science degree from USC.

name: Chris Hailey
title: Co-Founder
bio: Chris Hailey is a Co-Founder of OS3 (YC S26), a robotics company building semi-humanoid robots for real physical labor — pairing in-house hardware with AI models, with early deployments in hospitality. He previously co-founded Observee, which built integration infrastructure for vertical-AI companies: a single API and marketplace of 1,000+ Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for AI agents. Before founding these companies, Hailey worked as a software engineer at Coinbase. He holds a computer science degree from USC.

name: Daanish Jamal
bio: Daanish Jamal is the Founder and CEO of Dolomite Therapeutics, a biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics. Before Dolomite, Jamal was a principal and entrepreneur-in-residence at the life-sciences fund SR One, worked in business development at Skyhawk and Dragonfly Therapeutics, and was an associate partner at GreatPoint Ventures. He holds a BSBA in finance from Georgetown University.

name: Rahul Madduluri
investors: a16z, South Park Commons, Script Capital, 9Yards Capital,
bio: Rahul Madduluri is the Founder and CTO of Doppel, a cybersecurity company focusing on defense from social engineering attacks using AI. Doppel's mission is to rapidly detect and disrupt cybercrime. Madduluri is also an alumnus from USC and was a Software Engineer at Uber.

name: Anni Ankola
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Anni Ankola is the founder of Spyra Beauty, a social beauty review platform that helps users share skincare recommendations with friends while enabling brands to gather actionable consumer insights. Ankola holds a master’s degree from Cal Poly and previously worked as a data scientist at Memoria and Grafhopper.

name: Peter Gao
bio: Peter Gao is the Co-Founder and CEO of Aquarium Learning (YC 2020), which helped ML teams improve their models by finding and fixing the highest-impact errors in their training data. Gao co-founded Aquarium with Quinn Johnson, and the team joined Notion in 2024 to bring its AI retrieval technology to Notion's users.

name: Rishi Mandal
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Rishi Mandal is the Co-Founder and CEO of Future, a digital fitness platform that pairs members with expert human coaches for personalized training; in 2025 Future merged with Autograph. Mandal previously founded Sosh (acquired by Postmates), held product roles at Google and Slide, and was an entrepreneur-in-residence at Khosla Ventures. He studied astrophysics at Stanford University.

name: Justin Yang
title: Co-Founder
bio: Justin Yang is a Co-Founder of Pokedata, an early-stage startup he is currently building in stealth.

name: Ilya Sukhar
bio: Ilya Sukhar is the Co-Founder and CEO of Parse, a cloud platform that gave mobile developers a ready-made backend, which Facebook acquired in 2013. After the acquisition Sukhar led Facebook's developer-facing products and worked on Messenger, and he is now a General Partner at Matrix Partners. He holds bachelor's and master's degrees in computer science from Cornell University.

name: Anita Modi Gupta
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Anita Modi is the Co-Founder and CEO of Peer AI, a generative AI platform in order to expedite medical writing by processing data from clinical trials and/or regulatory documents. Its goal is to free medical writers from tedious tasks to focus on higher-value tasks. Modi was also the Co-Founder to Dash Genomics and on the founding team of Genos.

name: Tanuj Thapliyal
title: Founder/ CEO
bio: Tanuj Thapliyal is a Co-Founder of Kos.ai, a finance-AI venture. He is best known as the Co-Founder and CEO of Spot AI, the video-intelligence company; earlier he co-founded Mellow Research and was a hardware program engineer at Meraki. He holds an M.S. in electrical engineering from Stanford and an MBA from UCLA.

name: Ray Song
title: Founder & Core Contributor
investors: Primitive, Hashkey, Gate.io, Amush, Big Brain Collective
bio: Ray Song is a Founder and core contributor of aPriori, a trading-infrastructure layer that brings high-frequency-trading techniques on-chain — combining MEV-powered liquid staking with an AI-powered DEX aggregator on the Monad blockchain. Built by former Jump Trading and Coinbase quants and engineers, aPriori has raised roughly $30M.

name: Rishi Bhargava
title: Co-founder
bio: Rishi Bhargava is the Co-Founder of Descope, a drag-and-drop authentication and user-management (CIAM) platform built for developers. Bhargava previously co-founded Demisto, which created the security-orchestration category and was acquired by Palo Alto Networks, and earlier led products at Intel Security, McAfee, and Solidcore. He holds a degree from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi.

name: Barrett Glasauer
bio: Barrett Glasauer is the Co-Founder and CEO of Rejigg, which connects quality small business owners with vetted buyers, minimizing fees, eliminating brokers, and streamlining the acquisition process. Barrett is a graduate of UC Berkeley, and has previous experience at Palantir, Doordash, and WanderJaunt, where he was co-founder and CTO.

name: Arnav Joshi
title: Co-Founder
bio: Arnav Joshi is a Co-Founder of Refactor (YC), a startup deploying secure, reliable AI agents that operate legacy software — calling, clicking, and navigating systems — for large organizations across healthcare and other regulated industries. Joshi previously worked on autonomous-driving research at NVIDIA and in macro at Bridgewater Associates. He studied computer science (BS/MS) at Stanford University.

name: Rohan & Ayush Agrawal & Jain
title: Co-Founder & CEO/COO
bio: Ayush Jain is the Co-Founder of Concierge AI, a connected AI assistant for modern product teams, which can read and write to SaaS apps using conversational language. Jain is a Boston University alumnus and has extensive experience through roles at Stryker and Revolution, where he currently serves as a Venture Partner.

name: Stephen Hughes
investors: Conviction, Dylan Field, Jeff Dean, Genius Ventures
bio: Huxe, co-founded by Stephen Hughes (ex-Google NotebookLM), was an audio-AI app that turned a user's email, calendar, and interests into daily podcast-style briefings. It raised $4.6M before winding down in 2026.

name: Nick Sutardja
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Nick Sutardja is the Co-Founder and CEO of Danger Devices, a fabless semiconductor startup that designs self-optimizing integrated circuits to boost the performance of wired and wireless communication devices. He co-founded the company with Marvell founders Weili Dai and Sehat Sutardja. He holds a Ph.D. in integrated circuits from UC Berkeley.

name: Bryan Quinn
title: Co-Founder & President
bio: Bryan Quinn is the Co-Founder and CEO of Shopsense AI, a retail-media and adtech platform that makes TV and video content shoppable, connecting content, consumer intent, and commerce across the open internet. Quinn spent over a decade at Amazon Publisher Services before co-founding Shopsense with Glenn Fishback. He holds an MBA from the University of Notre Dame's Mendoza College of Business.

name: Kyle Li
bio: Kyle Li is a Co-Founder of Gait (YC F24), an open-source collaboration layer and developer infrastructure for AI coding assistants that helps engineering teams review and understand AI-generated code together. Li previously worked at Stripe and Jane Street.

name: Shivani Mitra
title: Co-Founder
investors: Paradigm, Robot Ventures, Chris Prucha, Balaji Srinivasan, Distributed Global, YONATAN BEN SHIMON, Thibaud Zamora, Gavin Uberti, OSS Capital L.P., Vipul Ved Prakash
bio: Nous Research, co-founded by Shivani Mitra, is an open-source AI lab building openly available large language models (the Hermes series) and decentralized training infrastructure. It has raised ~$65M led by Paradigm.

name: Drew Goldstein
title: Co-Founder
bio: Drew Goldstein is the Co-Founder of Ephemeral Technologies, a company founded to accelerate end-to-end drug development and delivery. Ephemeral is developing an integrated AI, software, and robotics platform by working backwards from high-value problems identified by an initial cohort of pharma companies, biotech startups, governmental organizations, and contract research organizations (CROs). Before Ephemeral, Goldstein built and ran Palantir’s healthcare business, which grew from 0 to $300M+ ARR.

name: Tushar Davé
title: CEO and Chairman
investors: Kubota, Nautilus Venture Partners, Acorn Pacific Ventures
bio: Tushar Davé is the Chairman and CEO of FarmX, an agriculture-technology company whose platform combines soil sensors, weather data, crop analytics, and automation into an autonomous farming system used by growers in the US, India, and Japan. Davé was previously founding Chairman and CEO of Enlighted, which was acquired by Siemens.

name: Jonathan Shih
title: Co-Founder & CTO
sector_raw: Real Estate Services (digital mortgage lender/home financing)
bio: Jonathan Shih is the Co-Founder and CTO of Pine, a Canadian mortgage underwriting company that enhances everything from helping the user find an appropriate property to issuing the mortgage for the property they selected. Pine has a referral partnership with fintech company WealthSimple and acquired another real estate company in Properly in 2023. Shih is a Berkeley Computer Engineering alumnus with a Master’s in Computer Science from UCLA. Prior to Pine, Shih was a Software Engineer for a multitude of companies, including Facebook, Shopagon, and Instabase.

name: David Zhu
title: Co-Founder
sector_raw: Technology, Information and Internet (AI data analysis)
bio: Percival (YC X25), co-founded by David Zhu, is an AI agent that automates data entry — turning inbound documents like purchase orders into structured records in business systems.

name: Jason Huang
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Jason Huang is the Founder and CEO of AWG, a chip-design company developing next-generation compound semiconductors (SiC and GaN) for energy-efficient EVs, AI data centers, and robotics. He holds a degree from San Jose State University.

name: Divyahans Gupta
title: Co-Founder & CTO
investors: Costanoa, General Catalyst, Lightspeed VP, D1 Capital
bio: Divyahans Gupta is the Co-Founder and CTO of Beacon Software, which partners with software companies to scale sustainably while preserving their legacy. Gupta is a Stanford alumnus. He has developed deep AI and engineering expertise through roles at leading firms such as Sequoia Capital, Airbnb, and Databricks.

name: Richard Wang
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Richard Wang is the Co-Founder and CEO of Clad Labs (YC F25), maker of Chad, an AI-powered coding IDE that folds quick breaks and mini-games into developer downtime. Before Clad, Wang did machine-learning research on semiconductor-fab data at a startup acquired by Tokyo Electron and worked at MIT Lincoln Laboratory. He holds a degree in computer science from Caltech.

name: Arjun Bhargava
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Arjun is a Co-Founder of Rye, an e-commerce API platform that enables merchants to plug in their inventory and sellers to access it through a unified, decentralized network. The platform integrates one-click checkout, Amazon and Shopify product data, and affiliate program connections. Prior to founding Rye, Arjun held technical roles at Goldman Sachs and Reddit. The company raised $14 million in 2022, led by a16z Crypto.

name: Rohan Chopra
title: Founder
bio: Rohan Chopra is the CEO and Co-Founder of Convey, a platform that lets anyone — technical or not — train AI to perform complex tasks. He was among the first 20 employees at DoorDash and previously a software engineer at LinkedIn. He holds a B.S. in computer science from Stanford University.

name: Andrew Liang
title: Co-Founder
invest: Series C - $64M      Series B: $33M; Series A: $15M
investors: Tiger Global Management, N47, New Enterprise Associates
bio: Andrew Liang is the Co-Founder and lead robotics engineer of Built Robotics, which builds AI guidance systems that turn heavy construction equipment into autonomous machines for jobs like solar-farm piling. Liang was previously a software engineer at Airware, working on safety-critical software for autonomous drones, and a research fellow at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. He holds an engineering degree from Caltech.

name: Jay Reddy
title: Co-Founder & CEO
investors: Innovation Works, NSF Convergence Accelerator, National Institute of Deafness & Comm. Disorders, Richard King Mellon Foundation, AlphaLab Health, Grant
bio: Jay Reddy is the Co-Founder and CEO of Advanced Optronics, a medical-device company whose micro-scale photonic sensors give surgeons real-time, AI-guided feedback during delicate procedures, starting with cochlear-implant surgery. Reddy co-founded the company out of Carnegie Mellon with Maysam Chamanzar. He holds a B.S. in electrical engineering and computer science from UC Berkeley and a Ph.D. in electrical and computer engineering from Carnegie Mellon University.

name: Isaac Madan
title: Co-Founder & CEO
investors: Bain VC, WestBridge, Pear VC, Venrock
bio: Isaac Madan is the Co-Founder and CEO of Nightfall AI, a company which harnesses AI to prevent, detect, and classify sensitive data to ensure its protection. Its mission is to prevent loss and manage risk for various platforms. Madan has a degree in CS and a PhD in bioinformatics from Stanford University.

name: Karthik Jagadeesh
title: Co-Founder & CDO
bio: Karthik Jagadeesh is the Co-Founder and CDO of TenSixty Biosciences, an AI bioscience company in order to revolutionize the treatment of cancer using cell models and machine learning. Their mission is to create a map of antibody targets on cancer cells. Jagadeesh is also a Berkley alumnus with a PhD in CS at Stanford University.

name: Sriram Prakash
title: Founder & CTO
bio: Sri Prakash was the Founder and CTO of Grey Matter Platforms, a company helping businesses make faster and more informed decisions by combining business intelligence and data analysis enterprise wide. The acquisition deal between Grey Matter Platforms and Saviance Technologies closed in March of 2018, with its announcement occurring in May. Before Grey Matter, Sri founded and worked as the CEO of BountyME from 2011 to 2015. BountyME is a platform built for talent acquisition that developed a Powerscore algorithm for recruiting and allowed users to monetize their professional networks.

name: Sriram Prakash
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Sri Prakash was the Founder and CTO of Grey Matter Platforms, a company helping businesses make faster and more informed decisions by combining business intelligence and data analysis enterprise wide. The acquisition deal between Grey Matter Platforms and Saviance Technologies closed in March of 2018, with its announcement occurring in May. Before Grey Matter, Sri founded and worked as the CEO of BountyME from 2011 to 2015. BountyME is a platform built for talent acquisition that developed a Powerscore algorithm for recruiting and allowed users to monetize their professional networks.

name: Jason Lin
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Jason Lin is a Co-Founder of Sidenote (YC S23), a Chrome extension that turns meeting notes into drafted emails, calendar invites, tickets, and reminders. He also co-founded Mida, which was acquired by the speech-AI company Sanas, where he now works. Lin is a Harker and Stanford computer-science alumnus.

name: Jason Lin
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Jason Lin is a Co-Founder of Mida, an information- and translation-technology startup that was acquired by Sanas, the real-time speech-AI platform where Lin now builds. He earlier co-founded Sidenote (YC S23), a meeting-follow-up automation tool. Lin is a Harker and Stanford computer-science alumnus.

name: Aumesh Misra
title: Co-Founder & CTO
bio: Aumesh Misra is a Co-Founder at Tivara, an AI company that automates insurance approval(prior authorization) for healthcare clinics, helping doctors deliver care to patients faster. Misra is an alumn of Washington University at St. Louis, and has gained tremendous experience in software engineering and data science through his work in Google and Compound

name: Omar Hamade
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Omar Hamade is the Founder and CEO of Hawala, a fintech building financial infrastructure that connects the Middle East and North Africa to global markets — offering digital USD and EUR wallets, instant transfers to 200+ countries, and a forthcoming card and interest-free savings product; it raised a $3M round. Hamade previously worked in business development and finance at Genentech. He holds a B.S. from Santa Clara University, was a Schwarzman Scholar at Tsinghua University, and studied at Harvard Business School.

name: Elizabeth Burnstien
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Elizabeth Burstein is the CEO and Co-Founder of Neura Health, a platform that connects patients with neurologists through integrated symptom tracking, diagnostic testing, HIPAA-compliant messaging, video visits, and a dedicated care concierge. She previously led product teams at Maven Clinic and Zocdoc, and began her career in product management at LinkedIn. Burstein holds dual degrees in Computer Science and Philosophy from Stanford University. Neura Health raised $2.2 million in seed funding in 2022.

name: Vamsi Gadiraju
title: Founder & CTO
bio: Vamsi Gadiraju is the Co-Founder and CTO of Superorder, a platform that streamlines the restaurant tech stack by unifying operations, reputation management, and delivery workflows—helping restaurants save time, consolidate vendors, and reduce costs. A Columbia University graduate, Gadiraju co-founded Superorder straight out of college and has since raised over $12 million from top-tier investors including Foundation Capital, Y Combinator, and Floodgate.

name: Preston Ellis
bio: Preston Ellis, Co-Founder of Axiom, is building a cross-chain trading platform enabling users to trade any asset on any blockchain — launching initially with Solana memecoins, Hyperliquid perpetuals, and yield products. A UC Berkeley EECS alumnus, Ellis led Axiom to $100M in revenue within four months of its Jan 2025 early-access launch, marking one of the fastest revenue trajectories in startup history. Axiom was part of Y Combinator Winter 2025.

name: J.T. Cho
title: Technical Co-Founder, CTO
bio: JT Cho is the Co-Founder and CTO at Ansa, a payment platform that provides merchants more leverage over payment fees and habitual spending with a closed-loop wallets at a fraction of the cost. Cho is a UPenn alumn, and has garnered experience in notable companies like Google, Affirm, and Linkedin.

name: Christopher Davis
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Christopher Davis is a Co-Founder of Loot Crate, a subscription-box service that delivered curated pop-culture, gaming, and geek merchandise to fans. Davis co-founded Loot Crate in 2012 and helped grow it into one of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States. He holds a degree from Claremont McKenna College.

name: Colt McNealy
title: Founder
bio: Colt McNealy is the Founder of LittleHorse Enterprises, a company to help users create reliable observable, and maintainable workflows. Its mission is to save time for developers rather than figuring out complicated systems. McNealy is a Stanford alumnus and was a Senior Software Engineer at REX.

name: Nikhil Panu
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Nikhil Panu is the Founder and CEO of Squadz, an online marketplace and social platform that connects athletes to pickup games, leagues, and local sports facilities and helps venues fill unused court and field time. A former Division III student-athlete, Panu holds a combined B.S./M.S. in computer science from Johns Hopkins University.

name: Josh Zloof
bio: Josh Zloof is the Co-Founder and CEO of Sudden Coffee, a specialty instant-coffee brand (Y Combinator W17) that shipped high-end single-serve coffee. Before Sudden Coffee, Zloof was a consultant at McKinsey, a product owner at Groupon, and held operations roles at Apple and Walmart.

name: Kevin Kim
title: Founder
bio: Kevin Kim is the Founder and CTO of Remy Security (YC S23), which uses AI to help security teams run design reviews quickly and thoroughly. He co-founded the company with Sten Sjöberg and was previously a software engineer at ExtraHop. He holds a degree in computer science from Rice University.

name: Vedant Shah
title: Founder
bio: Vedant Shah '18 is building a company in stealth.

name: Ethan Agarwal
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Ethan Agarwal is the Co-Founder and CEO of The Coterie, a fintech and wealth-management venture. Agarwal previously founded and led Aaptiv, an audio-fitness app that grew to more than one million paying members and roughly $100M in revenue before its assets were acquired, and earlier worked at McKinsey & Company, Citadel, and Lehman Brothers. He holds a B.A. in economics and political science from Johns Hopkins University and an MBA in finance from the Wharton School.

name: Ethan Agarwal
bio: Ethan Agarwal is the Founder and former CEO of Aaptiv, an audio-based fitness app that delivered trainer-led workouts and grew to over one million paying members across 20+ countries before its assets were acquired. Agarwal went on to found The Coterie, and earlier worked at McKinsey & Company, Citadel, and Lehman Brothers. He holds a B.A. in economics and political science from Johns Hopkins University and an MBA in finance from the Wharton School.

name: Neeraj Baid
title: Co-Founder & CTO
bio: Neeraj Baid is the Co-Founder and CTO of Atlantic Money, a fintech offering fixed-flat-fee international money transfers, which was later acquired. Baid spent roughly four years at Robinhood as an iOS engineer and then product manager, where he helped launch crypto trading, before leaving pre-IPO to start Atlantic Money. He holds a B.S. in electrical engineering and computer science from UC Berkeley.

name: Andy Fang
title: Co-Founder & CTO
bio: DoorDash is the largest food-delivery and local-commerce platform in the U.S., co-founded by Andy Fang. It went public on the NYSE in December 2020 and now spans restaurant, grocery, and retail delivery.

name: Andrew Jin
title: VP
bio: Andrew Jin is a Vice President of Engineering at Commure, an AI-native healthcare-technology company (formed after its 2023 merger with Athelas) building software to modernize clinical and administrative workflows across health systems. Jin focuses on scaling enterprise deployments and product execution in complex, regulated healthcare environments.

name: Varun Mohan
title: Founder
bio: Windsurf (formerly Codeium), co-founded by Varun Mohan, builds AI-powered developer tools and an agentic coding IDE. In 2025 its leadership and core technology were acquired amid a landmark deal involving Google and Cognition.

name: Manan Shah
title: Founding Member
bio: Manan Shah is a founding engineer at Kumo AI, which pioneers relational deep learning and graph neural networks so teams can make accurate predictions directly on their relational data without heavy feature engineering. Before Kumo, Shah was a machine-learning engineer at Snorkel AI. A Harker alumnus, he was a national finalist in the Siemens Competition for his research on modeling breast-cancer tumors.

name: Rohan Shah
title: Founder
bio: Rohan Shah is the Founder of Extend, a platform that lets merchants offer extended warranties and protection plans online, powering programs for brands like Peloton, Oura, and iRobot; Extend has raised over $320M at a $1.6B valuation. Shah previously founded WITHIN and spent four years at BCG Digital Ventures building new businesses with Fortune 500 companies. He is a Stanford alumnus and Forbes '30 Under 30' honoree.

name: Anuj Sharma
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Anuj Sharma is the Co-Founder and CEO of Decrypt Biomedicine, a biotech developing first-in-class small-molecule treatments for autoimmune disease by drugging 'cryptic' binding sites on hard-to-target proteins. He co-founded the company with Greg Bowman and holds a B.A. and an M.S. from Columbia University.

name: Tanuj Thapliyal
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Tanuj Thapliyal is the Co-Founder and CEO of Spot AI, whose video-intelligence platform turns ordinary security cameras into tools for safety, operations, and real-time incident detection. He founded Spot AI in 2018 with two Stanford friends, and previously co-founded Mellow Research and worked as a hardware program engineer at Meraki. He holds an M.S. in electrical engineering from Stanford and an MBA from UCLA.

name: Denny Tsai
title: Founder
bio: Denny Tsai is the Founder of Agence, a platform for building and deploying autonomous AI agents — with tool integrations, custom skills, knowledge bases, and multi-channel deployment from one system.

name: Howard Tsao
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Howard Tsao is the Founder and CEO of Muse Games, an independent game studio best known for the airship-combat series Guns of Icarus. He holds a B.A. in history and Asian studies from UC Berkeley and an MBA in marketing from NYU's Stern School of Business.

name: Sean Turner
title: Co-Founder and CTO
bio: Swiftly, co-founded by Sean Turner, is a retail-technology platform that helps brick-and-mortar retailers and CPG brands deliver personalized digital experiences and retail-media advertising.

name: Johnny Wang
title: Founder
bio: Johnny Wang co-founded Crosswire (2021), an enterprise access-management startup that helped security engineers manage access at scale. He went on to co-found the Y Combinator–backed cybersecurity company Hinoki Security. Wang studied computer science at Columbia and previously worked in security at companies including Google.

name: Sean Doherty
bio: Sean Doherty is the Co-Founder and CEO of Awary, a cybersecurity company that turns digital safety into a shared opportunity. By rewarding smarter online behavior, Awary helps financial institutions actively engage consumers in preventing fraud. Doherty is a seasoned entrepreneur, having previously founded Wurl (acquired for $430M) and Skyline Wireless.

name: Ravi Mishra
title: Co-Founder & CEO
investors: Y Combinator (Fall 2026), A Tribe Capital GP, multiple exited CTOs, and senior operators from Google, Meta and Block
bio: Ravi Mishra is the Co-Founder and CEO of Ample, an infrastructure company whose product deploys a full application from a single prompt to a coding agent, handling hosting, configuration and scaling behind the scenes. A three-time founder with one exit, he founded and exited Athleauge in 2013 and was a Senior Product Manager at Shopify, where he met Ample's CTO, Ishan.
